scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "server,teacher,student,super_admin,admin,shared-schemas,client-next,common-ui,auth-bff" -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan,white,gray,black,red" "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter dashboard dev:teacher" "pnpm --filter dashboard dev:student" "pnpm --filter dashboard dev:super_admin" "pnpm --filter dashboard dev:admin" "pnpm run dev:shared-schemas" "pnpm run dev:client-next" "pnpm run dev:common:ui" "pnpm run dev:auth-bff"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n client,dashboard,server -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter client-next build" "pnpm --filter dashboard build" "pnpm --filter server build"
scripts.build:client:core: pnpm --filter @school/shared-schemas build && pnpm --filter @school/common-ui build && pnpm --filter client-next build
scripts.build:client:cf: pnpm --filter @school/shared-schemas build && pnpm --filter @school/common-ui build && pnpm --filter client-next build:cf
scripts.preview:client:cf: pnpm --filter @school/shared-schemas build && pnpm --filter @school/common-ui build && pnpm --filter client-next preview:cf
scripts.deploy:client:cf: pnpm --filter @school/shared-schemas build && pnpm --filter @school/common-ui build && pnpm --filter client-next deploy:cf
scripts.build:dashboard:core: pnpm --filter @school/shared-schemas build && pnpm --filter @school/common-ui build && pnpm --filter dashboard build
